sentences.text:
It is submitted by the learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Mr. Gogoi, that this is a case registered under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act and hence the victim/informant should be made necessary party in this case before passing any order on bail.
It is to be mentioned here that the Hon'ble Division Bench of this Court in Crl. A.(J)/40/20222, vide order dated 23.06.2023, had formulated some guidelines and accordingly, it is mandatory to implead the victim/informant as respondent even in the bail application.
In view of above and also considering the nature of allegation brought against the present petitioner

,
I find it necessary to implead the informant/victim as party respondent here in this petition.
Accordingly, the petitioner is hereby directed to do the needful to implead the victim/informant of this case as respondent No. 2 here in this case.

In the meantime, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor shall return the Case Diary to the I.O.
concerned and shall produce the updated Case Diary Page No.# 3/3 before this Court on the next date fixed.
